column3: Close to the Hebrew; “stone” is rendered “ore.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stone of gloom” is rendered “ore in the darkness,” and וְצַלְמָוֶת “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “away from a sojourner” is rendered “away from people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the sons of pride” is rendered “The proud lions,” and “a lion” “the fierce lion.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from weeping” is rendered “from trickling.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּזְכוֹכִית (“glass”) is rendered “crystal,” and “vessel” “jewelry.”
Close to the Hebrew; the gem terms are rendered “coral or quartz,” and מִפְּנִינִים (“pearls/corals”) “above rubies.”
Close to the Hebrew; כּוּשׁ (“Cush”) is rendered “Ethiopia.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֲבַדּוֹן (“Abaddon”) is translated “Destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the storm of thunderclaps” is rendered “the thunderbolt.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV makes the pronoun explicit, “He saw wisdom.”
